channel.title: SnapDeck AI Blog
channel.description: Study tips, memory science and exam prep for students — from the team behind SnapDeck AI.

item.title: How to study from bullet-point lecture slides when they say nothing
item.description: Your slides are thin on content and you're left with bullet points that help you remember nothing. Here's how to turn them into something that actually works.

item.title: How to memorise a lot of material fast — the method that works
item.description: You have a lot to remember and not much time. Here's the system for turning heavy material into recall that sticks — without re-reading everything.

item.title: How to study when you're too tired to focus properly
item.description: You're exhausted and your brain won't absorb anything. Here's what is actually worth doing at forty percent capacity — and when it's time to stop.

item.title: How to study when you can't focus for more than ten minutes
item.description: You can't force focus — it's not willpower. Here's how to study with a short attention span instead of against it.

item.title: Failed an Exam? What Now: A Step-by-Step Recovery Guide
item.description: You failed an exam and now you're stuck. Here's what to do: diagnose what went wrong, reset, and build a plan that actually works this time.
